entries: Second-stage joint-noise test; J1939+2134 retrospective sensitivity curve

Retrospective curve on simulated data at reduced size (8 periods, 16 injections per step). With white-only true noise the second stage needs 1.2-1.5 times the ideal amplitude from 30 to 234 d, 2.1 at 449 d, 3.1 at 634 d and 10.1 at 1078 d (0.66 us ideal, 6.6 us second stage). With the reference red noise as truth the ratio is 1.2-1.4 to 449 d, 1.9 at 634 d and 2.6 at 1078 d. Largest second-stage amplitude over all generators at 1078 d: 249 us.
No observed residuals read; consumed run untouched. Coarser than the other curves. Open decision: narrow the noise grid where a released chain exists.
